scope.summary: Identity, MCP tool authorization, and the boundaries between the public and private tiers.
scope.built: Separate public and private binaries (ADR security/004), public_reader role with visibility filters on the replica, Turnstile-gated chat with three nested budgets, PrincipalMiddleware bearer-token verification on every MCP message, GroupPolicyMiddleware denying every MCP tool call outside the operators group (no tool tagged mcp:public), Discord trust ledger with per-guild per-user scoring and heuristics-fed instant enforcement, Cloudflare Access lane projecting verified email to agents console, Kubernetes RBAC scoping cluster mutation (ArgoCD sync, per-Kargo-project promote Roles) to the private pod.

losses.title: Data is corrupted, or a side-effecting action (Discord post, agent run, chat_public write) is duplicated or forged
Anonymous or public-tier caller reads data it is not entitled to (private rows, ungoverned paths)
A secret or token reaches a tier or surface that must not hold it
Attacker exhausts shared compute (GPU, sandbox, shotter) or causes denial of service
A controller serves stale or wrong data while believing it correct

hazards.statement: GroupPolicyMiddleware restricts monolith MCP tool calls to operators.
Published documents must stay within the public content boundary.
The public_reader role reads public datasets and the public view of knowledge notes.
Public writes are confined to chat_public and its admission and inference budgets.
Public routes serve public frontend paths and assets.
Each tier receives only the credentials required by its role.
The operators gate controls access to scratch-database execution.
The operators gate controls capture of private-tier screenshots stored in SeaweedFS.

ucas.condition: The gateway routes page and API-facing browser traffic to the public frontend.
Public chat admission requires Turnstile verification and enforces session limits and a cluster-wide inference cap.
Database grants scope public_reader to public tables and visibility-filtered views.
The public manifest generator checks allowlisted content for internal identifiers before publication.
Private-tier screenshots require an authorized operators-group caller.
Running sandbox code with scratch-database access requires operators group membership.
GroupPolicyMiddleware gates ArgoCD sync and Kargo promotion calls on operators group membership.
Starting or driving an agent session through MCP requires operators group membership.
Pardoning a chat user through MCP requires operators group membership.
The public backend holds the Turnstile secret for verification. The frontend receives the public site key.

unsafe_feedback.signal: allowlisted document content published to public site
unsafe_feedback.condition: The public manifest generator checks content from allowlisted paths before publication.
